html: † [הַרְמוֹן] n.m. meaning dub.; text perhaphs corrupt; only Am 4:3 וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּנָֿה הַהַרְמ֫וֹנָה and ye shall cast them (your אחרית, posterity, AE; Hi RV cast [yourselves], but read rather with Vrss as pass. וְהָשְׁל׳ shall be cast) into Harmon; if text be sound, some locality must be meant, though the nature of the allusion is lost (AV, into the palace, treats הרמון improb. as = ארמון). 𝔗 𝔖 have mountain(s) of Armenia (הַר מוֹנָה), Symm Armenia, cf. LagGes. Abh. 172, HoffmZAW iii. 1882, 102, of exile; Hi-St for ה׳ read הֲדַדְרִמּוֹנָה to Hadadrimmon, n.pr.loc. in plain of Jezreel, so Gunning; 𝔊 εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ῥομμαν, whence Ew ingeniously ההר רמונה and ye shall cast Rimmonah (name of idol, supposed fem. of Rimmon 2 K 5:18) to the mountains.
